description: This file contains internal structures, inline functions, and static functions for managing the Memory Protection Unit (MPU) on ARM Cortex-M processors within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes configuration, region management, and validation functions specific to ARM MPU v8 architecture, with support for dynamic and static region programming.

methods.name: mpu_set_mair0
methods.description: Sets the MAIR0 register for cache-ability attributes, architecture-dependent implementation.

methods.name: mpu_set_rnr
methods.description: Sets the MPU region number register.

methods.name: mpu_set_rbar
methods.description: Sets the MPU region base address register.

methods.name: mpu_get_rbar
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the MPU region base address register.

methods.name: mpu_set_rlar
methods.description: Sets the MPU region limit address register.

methods.name: mpu_get_rlar
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the MPU region limit address register.

methods.name: mpu_get_num_regions
methods.description: Returns the number of MPU regions supported by the hardware.

methods.name: mpu_clear_region
methods.description: Disables a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_region_get_base
methods.description: Returns the base address of a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_region_set_base
methods.description: Sets the base address of a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_region_get_last_addr
methods.description: Returns the last address of a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_region_set_limit
methods.description: Sets the limit address of a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_region_get_conf
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a specified MPU region.

methods.name: mpu_buffer_validate
methods.description: Validates if a memory buffer is accessible according to MPU and security configurations.

methods.name: mpu_configure_region
methods.description: Configures a specific MPU region with given partition attributes.

methods.name: mpu_configure_regions_and_partition
methods.description: Programs multiple MPU regions over a background area, optionally performing sanity checks.

methods.name: mpu_configure_static_mpu_regions
methods.description: Configures static MPU regions for the system.

methods.name: mpu_mark_areas_for_dynamic_regions
methods.description: Marks and stores configuration for regions where dynamic MPU programming is allowed.

methods.name: get_num_regions
methods.description: Returns the number of supported MPU regions.

methods.name: mpu_configure_dynamic_mpu_regions
methods.description: Programs dynamic MPU regions based on provided partitions.

methods.name: region_init
methods.description: Initializes an MPU region with specified configuration.

methods.name: mpu_partition_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a partition's start address and size are valid for MPU configuration.

methods.name: get_region_index
methods.description: Returns the MPU region index that contains a given address range.

methods.name: get_dyn_region_min_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum index among dynamic regions marked for MPU configuration.
